evidence.note: Environment probing: checks python3/node/npm/pip availability, python version + installed packages, installs aiohttp/aiosqlite, confirms runtime constraints before designing. No explicit Chromium/browser probe despite CUA grading.

Explicitly extracted and verified the dense-per-channel-seq-across-writers invariant (web seq=1, IRC seq=2) and that seq stays dense (1-5) after broadcaster kill — a subtle load-bearing contract, actively confirmed.

Pulled specific spec edges from memory into checks: /me kept literally as '/me <text>', empty-message no-blank-post validation, and the workspace-general-submit testid — showing targeted contract recall beyond generic CRUD.
Systematically cross-referenced the served SPA against the full data-testid list from the spec, diagnosing false 'missing' matches as regex artifacts rather than real gaps.
Verified explicit status codes (400 invalid username, 409 duplicate) and node_id 0/1/2 port indexing against the health contract.

Extraction is done inline as build/verify analysis notes rather than as a distilled, revisited contract inventory; deepest traps (transfer-ownership vs PATCH-to-owner, guest/member/admin channel gates, non-member mention exclusion, resume.gap) are not surfaced or reasoned about explicitly.

reasoning: The agent confirmed the runtime (language, framework, packages, listening ports) and caught most explicit status codes, envelope keys, and testids — clearly at the level-5 bar — and went beyond it by surfacing several genuinely subtle traps (dense-seq-across-writers verified live, /me literal body, node_id port indexing, empty-message validation) and systematically cross-referencing the full testid list against the spec. However, it never produced a distilled, referenced contract inventory nor a living, revisited map, left several of the sharpest traps (transfer-ownership vs PATCH, guest/member/admin gates, non-member mention exclusion, resume.gap boundaries) unaddressed in the trajectory, and skipped probing for the browser. That places it solidly between the 5 and 8 anchors.
